### sqliteD1()

```ts
function sqliteD1(sqlite): AppReleaseD1Database;
```

Adapt caller-owned Node SQLite to the catalog's D1 transport for tests and quick
starts. The caller applies schema and closes the database. This is not a
Cloudflare emulator or an isolation boundary.
